points.text: Simple algebraic division; use of Only division by ( ax + b ) or ( ax – b ) will be required, e.g. the Factor Theorem and the b Remainder Theorem. students should know that if f( x ) = 0 when x = , a then ( ax – b ) is a factor of f( x ). Students may be required to factorise cubic expressions such as x 3 + 3 x 2 − 4 and 6 x 3 + 11 x 2 − x − 6. Students should be familiar with the terms ‘quotient’ and ‘remainder’ and be able to determine the remainder when the polynomial f( x ) is divided by ( ax + b ).
